items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Sweets and I went to work with Buddy Rich and Marty Page

ctx.x: What did you do after Las Vegas?
Well, I came back here and Sweets and I went to work with Buddy Rich and Marty Page, at the Melody Room on Sunset Boulevard.
